events.summary: Aptamirror has gone gold!The full game is finished. All 50 puzzles, all 10 chapters (and maybe something more for the best of the best...), done and locked in for release on November 3rd. Thank you to everyone who has followed, wishlisted, and played along the way.Steam Next Fest is here, and so is the demo!Aptamirror is a calm, meditative puzzle game about folding. events.title: Aptamirror Demo is LIVE!
events.summary: The Aptamirror demo is now playable on Steam.Fold molecules into target shapes across 20 puzzles spanning the first four chapters of the full game. The demo includes the introduction to all four folding tools (Grab, Mutate, Cleave, Ligate) and demonstrates the meditative puzzle approach the full game will explore in depth in the full release.
